name: gentle-shell
description: gentle-shell is a coding-agent workspace and TUI harness built for Pi: agent orchestration, ODD workflow tracking, native review, diff views and persistent memory, driven from the terminal. This script creates an LXC development server with gentle-shell, git and the GitHub CLI preinstalled, ready to be used over SSH.

notes.text: gentle-shell is a terminal application: connect via SSH (root) and run 'gentle-shell'; its setup completes on first launch. Projects live in /root/projects.
To use it as a Herdr dev server, add this container to ~/.ssh/config on your desktop machine (Host <hostname>, User root) and select it with Add Machine in Herdr.
Without a GitHub token, run 'gh auth login' inside the container to authenticate the GitHub CLI.

app_vars.name: var_hostname
app_vars.label: Machine Name
app_vars.help: Container hostname; Herdr shows it as the remote machine name

app_vars.name: var_projects_mode
app_vars.label: Projects Storage
app_vars.help: internal = /root/projects on the LXC disk; external = a new mountpoint on a Proxmox storage

app_vars.name: var_projects_storage
app_vars.label: Proxmox Storage (external mode)
app_vars.help: Proxmox storage for the projects volume, e.g. local-lvm (external mode only)

app_vars.name: var_projects_size
app_vars.label: Projects Volume Size (GB)
app_vars.help: Size in GB of the external projects volume (external mode only)

app_vars.name: var_gh_token
app_vars.label: GitHub Token
app_vars.help: Optional GitHub Personal Access Token: create it at github.com -> Settings -> Developer settings -> Personal access tokens (scope 'repo'). When empty, authenticate later with 'gh auth login' inside the container
